webp.comment: Clone/install dir is webp (must match LIBS_DIR/webp and FindSneezeWebp). Upstream repo is still libwebp.git. Decoder only (webpdecoder). glTF assets optimized by glTF-Transform ship EXT_texture_webp base-color/metallic-roughness maps; stb_image cannot decode WebP, so IMAGE::Decode routes RIFF/WEBP data through libwebp's WebPDecodeRGBA. Built decode-only (tools/mux/encoder off).

sneeze-sdk.comment: Tracks main. main carries the TEMPORARY_DIGIT_KEYS ABI slot kSNEEZE_ABI_METHOD_VIEWPORT_KEY=60 that Sneeze's digit-key integration (Container/Wasm_Store/Viewport/Compositor) requires, plus the viewport pointer notify and node-model ABI methods (merged from the former 'panel-updates' feature branch). Sneeze HostFunctions.cpp also requires the FABRIC node-tree + SERVICES ABI (kSNEEZE_ABI_METHOD_SERVICES_*, kSNEEZE_ABI_METHOD_FABRIC_NODE_*, SNEEZE_ABI_MAP_SERVICE) from include/sneeze_abi.h. main gets rewritten/force-pushed and orphaned SHAs break fresh shallow clones (Mac/Linux CI: 'fatal: unable to read tree'), so a live branch tip is tracked rather than a raw SHA. -Sync fast-forwards to the branch tip.

socketio.comment: Pinned to a master SHA, not the newest tag 3.1.0 (2021): 3.1.0 hard-caps its TLS target at C++11, which fails to compile against modern BoringSSL's C++17 openssl/span.h. master relaxed that cap to a C++11 minimum, so it builds at C++17 unpatched.

rmap.comment: Tracks main alongside map below (ObjectHead API: OBJECTHEAD twParentIx/wClass_Parent -> Parent/Self; OBJECTIX moved into RMAP). Sneeze source (Container.cpp/Node.cpp/Compositor.cpp) targets this API. -Sync fast-forwards to latest main; keep rmap and map moving together.

map.comment: Tracks main alongside rmap above (ObjectHead API: MAP_OBJECT_POD drops OBJECT_HEAD Head; MAP_OBJECT::Create takes (wClass, twObjectIx, POD) and MAP_OBJECT exposes m_wClass/m_twObjectIx). Consumed by Sneeze's migrated Container.cpp/Node.cpp. -Sync fast-forwards to latest main; keep map and rmap moving together.

filament.comment: Adds a per-light global flag: a point/spot light marked global bypasses Filament's froxel (clustered) culling and is evaluated on every lit fragment, so a source far outside the froxel-safe band (a star, or a light nested in a hugely-scaled fabric) still lights the scene. Halogen v1.1.22 forwards the flag and requires this tag. mv.7 fixes the frustum cull culling every renderable under the Clang fast-math build on Apple Silicon. (mv.4-mv.6 chased a math::fast::signbit miscompile -- a red herring; the sign extraction was always correct.) The real cause: scenes with an extreme depth range make the far plane near-degenerate, so clang's fast-math 1/length(.xyz) in Frustum::setProjection overflows to Inf/NaN and poisons mPlanes[4]; Culler's dot<0 visibility test then fails for that plane (NaN<0 is false) and culls everything. setProjection now detects any plane with a non-finite component via an integer exponent test (immune to fast-math) and replaces it with (0,0,0,-1), which both the box and sphere tests read as always-inside. MSVC computes the reciprocal finite, so Windows was always fine.

halogen.comment: v1.1.25 lets a linear image2D sampler stay on one level when the Halogen mipmap parameter is false, so UI text is not blurred by a lower mip. The default remains mipmapped. Otherwise v1.1.24: keeps a same-size image2D Filament texture across sampler recommits. Destroying it left panel MaterialInstances bound to an invalid texture and FEngine::prepare aborted (live panels such as the dfw-live clock and ATC). Otherwise v1.1.22: rebind of kept instance renderables when their geometry regenerates buffers, glTF ORM/normal/occlusion maps, sRGB textures, KHR_texture_transform, specular IBL cubemap, and GEN_MIPMAPPABLE on IBL/image2D so generateMipmaps does not abort. Built with stock full post-processing on every backend -- the native-direct patch that disabled post-processing on native surfaces has been removed; that patch (not a Halogen bug) was the cause of the orange sun / dark logo. Post-processing is safe on Apple Silicon again now that Filament v1.71.0.mv.7 fixes the fast-math frustum cull. Requires Filament v1.71.0.mv.7. v1.1.23 (native-surface sRGB) stays unpublished; that change was dropped because the orange sun was the native-direct post-processing patch, not a Halogen bug.
